title: Ruff version must be bumped in pyproject.toml (lint extra and tool.ruff.required-version) and requirements/lint-requirements.txt together
answers: How do I upgrade Ruff in this repo without breaking lint?
Ruff check fails with a required-version mismatch after bumping the version
Where is the Ruff version pinned for the dev environment and CI lint?
Why does dev-env-setup install an old Ruff that rejects every run?
body:
Invariant: the Ruff version is pinned in three places that must change together: the `lint` extra's `ruff==X` in pyproject.toml, `[tool.ruff] required-version` in pyproject.toml, and the `ruff==X` line in requirements/lint-requirements.txt.
Enforced by: `[tool.ruff] required-version` in pyproject.toml makes any other installed Ruff version refuse to run; dev/dev-env-setup.sh installs requirements/lint-requirements.txt, so a stale line there installs the old version.
What breaks if skipped: bumping only pyproject.toml leaves dev-env-setup installing the previous Ruff, and every `ruff format` / `ruff check` invocation fails the required-version check (the review on PR #26195 caught this).
Fix pattern: change all three pins to the same version in one commit, then refresh uv.lock without altering the cooldown exclusion.
Constraints: this covers only the Ruff pin; other lint tools (pre-commit, mypy) are pinned in the same files but are not gated by required-version.
applies: Any change to the Ruff version or other lint-tool pins in this repository's dev tooling.
says: Development environment setup installs an outdated linter that refuses to run formatting checks
Code style checks fail with a version mismatch error after updating the linter
Developer setup scripts install the wrong linter version causing pull request checks to fail
Local code formatting commands reject every file due to an unexpected tool version
Upgrade the code formatting linter across developer environments and pull request quality checks
search: Upgrades to Ruff must synchronize the version pin across pyproject.toml (the lint extra and [tool.ruff] required-version) and requirements/lint-requirements.txt in a single commit before refreshing uv.lock. If skipped, dev/dev-env-setup.sh installs the old pinned version from requirements/lint-requirements.txt, causing ruff format and ruff check to fail the required-version check. The requirement applies strictly to Ruff pins without changing the cooldown exclusion, and does not govern other lint tools like pre-commit or mypy.
